stories.title: Example: reject invoices with a non-positive total
stories.i_want: the system to refuse to create an invoice whose total is zero or negative
stories.so_that: we never issue meaningless or refund-shaped invoices by accident

acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN CreateInvoice is called with a total greater than zero, the system shall return an invoice in state Draft.
IF CreateInvoice is called with a total of zero or less, THEN the system shall return the domain error ErrNonPositiveTotal and create nothing.

decisions.text: Zero counts as non-positive: an invoice for nothing is refused, not issued as a free one.
